test_title: PYST 17: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The accused __has been tortured__ before he was brought to the court.
solution: The correct answer is** 'had been tortured'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here,** 'had been tortured' **should be used instead of **'has been tortured'.** • The given sentence is in the** past tense.** • Hence, the other **clause** should also be in the same **tense**. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *The accused **had been tortured **before he was brought to the court.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहाँ **'has been tortured'** के स्थान पर** 'had been tortured' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • दिया गया वाक्य **past tense** में है। • अत: दूसरा **clause** भी उसी काल में होना चाहिए। • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 2 **है। 38:Tc7b, The correct answer is** 'have called off'.**
